Get Inside The Mind Of Gordon Ryan As He Teaches The Systems And Strategies Behind His Historic Double-Gold ADCC Performance

Learn  How To Pull Off Every Major Move That Gordon Used At ADCC 2019 - He Shows You Step By Step: You Can Do This



Enjoy a Free Sample:

What Will You Learn?

In an unprecedented series, follow Gordon Ryan’s dominant ADCC run as he shows the techniques and strategies behind his double gold performance. Gordon stormed his way to championships in the -99kg and absolute divisions, beating champions like Buchecha, Hulk Barbosa, and Garry Tonon with six submissions in his eight matches.

Now he breaks down every match, moment by moment, with commentary and then technical breakdowns of the dominant performances on this 8-volume series.

Learn the systems that have made Gordon Ryan the best no-gi grappler on Earth, including the back attacks he used to rack up 5 wins against elite opponents and cement himself as one of the best submission hunters ever.

Gordon takes every match and breaks down what he was doing, why he was doing it, and the key details that gave him the edge. This commentary brings you inside the mind of this one-of-a-kind athlete, giving strategic insights in real time.

After every match, Gordon shows the key moves and positions that happened in the match, and what he was doing to ensure victory. Every technique is something that anyone can do, with the right timing and positioning, and Gordon Ryan shows you how. Get the same advice and coaching that made Gordon the best in the world, including his gameplan, mindset, and thoughts around the infamous Buchecha match (called “the biggest match in grappling history”).

Gordon is here teaching his signature moves, including the submissions that worked against fighters like Garry Tonon, Lachlan Giles, Vinicius Gazola, and more! Learn the back attacks and leg locks Gordon is notorious for, and the open guard system never before put together in this much detail (including the sumi gaeshi sweep that he used in the absolute finals). This is an honest and open discussion of high-level technique that any grappler can use to focus their game around what works against everyone.

Most high level grapplers depend on some combination of technique and athleticism, but every move shown here can be used by anyone with enough precision. Go deeper than ever into this flawless 8-match run to the top by hearing from the man himself, including the advice he was getting from John Danaher and the crazy circumstances behind the camp he had leading up to the event (and how close it was to not happening at all!).

With direct match commentary and complete technique breakdowns, Gordon Ryan shows you how he won a gold medal at his very first ADCC World Championship!

Attack The Arms With Systematic, Detailed Submission Threats From ADCC Medalist Lachlan Giles & Learn The Best Ways To Use Some Of Grappling’s Most Common and Effective Straight Armocks
  • Combine straight arm locks, armbars, choi bars, and more to finish more submission holds and threaten your opponents more often

Learn the most effective ways to attack the upper body, taught by ADCC medalist and black belt instructor Lachlan Giles on this new 8-part series that shows every detail of these submission systems. Increase your finishing percentage, see how to troubleshoot your way out of common counters and escapes, and get the most breaking power possible on the arms with these lessons in submission grappling mastery.

Lachlan Giles is an incredibly technical black belt, who used his submission systems and tricky game to go on an incredible ADCC absolute run and secure his spot on the podium. As an instructor, Lachlan is recognized as one of BJJ Fanatics’s most thorough and detailed instructors, with hours of systematic content broken down so grapplers of all levels can learn and retain knowledge the best way possible.

Set up and finish armbars from tons of common positions, including Lachlan’s system for troubleshooting and breaking grips that will simplify your life. Get great choi bars and use shoulder crunches to submit and improve position, and set up offense from open guard and half butterfly.

With step-by-step analysis of your options, Lachlan helps give you a conceptual roadmap from each position that you can use for the most systematic and complete armlocks possible. Watch these systems in action as Lachlan includes gym footage of him sparring specifically with these techniques, so you can learn from someone going live and working against resistance.

products.title: My Evolution Your Revolution 2022 ADCC Scrimmage Analysis by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
The standing exchange decides who gets to impose their game, and nobody has shown that more clearly at ADCC than Gordon Ryan.

  • ADCC World Champion in 2017, 2019 and 2022, winner of the 2022 superfight against André Galvão, and one of the most dominant no gi grapplers of all time.
  • In My Evolution Your Revolution 2022 ADCC Scrimmage Analysis, Ryan breaks down the standing exchanges of his 2022 ADCC matches against Victor Hugo, Roosevelt Sousa, Nicky Rodriguez and André Galvão, including the mindset he brought into each one.
  • This isn't just a match review, it's a look at how the best in the world thinks, feints and reacts on the feet under the highest pressure.


What Will You Learn?

The standing exchange decides who gets to impose their game, and nobody has shown that more clearly at ADCC than Gordon Ryan.

Gordon Ryan earned his black belt under Garry Tonon in 2016 and went on to win ADCC gold in 2017, 2019 and 2022, taking double gold at the 2019 event and beating André Galvão by rear naked choke in the 2022 superfight. Now he's sharing what was going through his head in every standing exchange of that 2022 run.

In My Evolution Your Revolution 2022 ADCC Scrimmage Analysis, Ryan breaks down the feints, snaps, collar ties and ashi entries he used against each opponent, why some attempts failed, and how he adjusted. This isn't just a match review, it's a look at how the best in the world thinks, feints and reacts on the feet under the highest pressure.

Whether you compete in no gi or simply want to stop losing the first exchange of every roll, the scrimmage is where your game starts. You'll see the elastic method, multi snaps, the kouchi snap, collar tie to ashi pulls, countering a Granby, defending the armdrag and knowing when to allow a takedown, all in real matches at the highest level.

What makes this analysis valuable is that it happened for real. These aren't cooperative demonstrations, they're decisions made against elite opponents who were trying to do the same thing to him, and Ryan explains the reasoning behind each one, including how he prepared mentally for every opponent.

If you've ever wondered how elite grapplers decide when to shoot, when to pull and when to wait, this is your answer.

Learn how to win the standing exchange with Gordon Ryan's breakdown of his 2022 ADCC run.
